Get home safe

18+ only. Carry ID.

Book the ride from inside

Wait indoors until your Uber, Bolt or Little driver arrives, and check the plate matches.

Keep your drink with you

Don't leave drinks unattended or accept drinks from strangers.

Share your plans

Tell a friend where you are going and share your ride in the app.

Pay at the bar

Use the venue's official till or card machine, not a personal M-Pesa number.
